parsed.note_claim: The video shows a typical example of illegal street vending (top manta) on Madrid's Gran Vía, where counterfeit goods are spread on sheets and quickly bundled with ropes to flee when police approach.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Todas las mantas tienen dos cuerdas cruzadas de esquina a esquina. En caso de que se acerque la policía, tiran de ellas y salen andando con total tranquilidad.
parsed.reason: The El País article directly describes the top manta phenomenon on Gran Vía with counterfeit goods bundled using crossed ropes to flee police, exactly matching the note's description.
